meta.subject: RASTER_UNIT: Temp fix for power of 2 window size issue

en.summary: Temporarily fixes a raster edge-clipping bug by disabling an incorrect quad bounds check in the quad evaluator.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly identifies a raster window-size bug.
The patch changes DUT quad mask generation in VX_raster_qe.sv.
Even though it is a temporary workaround, it changes whether valid samples are incorrectly discarded at the render boundary.
disqualifiers: The commit is explicitly a temporary workaround and was superseded by the more precise follow-up fix in c20232a97a3830ec8581ca65ee8cb346414bc69f.
evidence: The commit comments out the in-bounds predicate around mask and barycentric writes, instead of changing any surrounding flow control.
dst_width, dst_height, x_loc_r, and y_loc_r are marked UNUSED immediately after the check is disabled.
The later follow-up fix restores the check with ((x_loc_r >> 1) + i) and ((y_loc_r >> 1) + j), confirming the original predicate used the wrong coordinate domain.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A raster or tile evaluator often tracks quad location in a coarser or scaled coordinate domain, while the render target width and height are expressed in pixel coordinates. If the boundary clip check compares the scaled quad coordinates directly against pixel-space limits, valid edge samples can be rejected. This temporary source commit worked around that by disabling the buggy check entirely.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: quad boundary clipping with mismatched coordinate domains
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Quads near the right or bottom edge when the evaluator stores location in a scaled or tile-relative domain but compares it directly to pixel dimensions.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Re-enable the original in-bounds condition that uses the unconverted quad coordinates directly against pixel-space width and height.
portability_notes: Map this to any raster, tile, or block evaluator that converts between quad/tile coordinates and pixel coordinates.
The characteristic fault is false rejection of valid edge samples, not overdraw from the interior of the primitive.
This specific source commit is a workaround; it is useful for injection because it identifies the exact pre-fix predicate to restore.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the per-sample or per-quad in-bounds predicate that gates output masks at the render target edge.
Use the stored quad or tile coordinate directly in the comparison instead of first converting it back to pixel coordinates.
Keep the inside-triangle test unchanged so only the boundary clipping behavior regresses.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Quad evaluator boundary predicate around mask and barycentric writes
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The workaround comments out the check `(x_loc_r + i) < dst_width && (y_loc_r + j) < dst_height`, which had been dropping valid samples.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the commented-out `if ((x_loc_r + i) < dst_width && (y_loc_r + j) < dst_height)` guard around the mask and barycentric assignments.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Valid pixels near the render-window edge are masked off because the bounds check uses the wrong coordinate scale.
evidence_for_injection: The commit changes only the boundary predicate, not the edge-function evaluation itself.
The immediately following commit replaces the removed check with a shifted version, which explains what the original bug was.
The subject line explicitly ties the failure to window-size handling.
notes: Because this is a temporary workaround, it should be read together with the later proper fix when reasoning about the root cause.
For dataset usability, the portable description above states the underlying coordinate-domain bug rather than merely saying “comment out the check.”

zh.summary: 该提交通过临时关闭 quad evaluator 中错误的边界检查，暂时修复了一个 raster 边缘裁剪 bug。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确指出这是 raster window-size 相关 bug。
补丁修改的是 VX_raster_qe.sv 中 DUT 的 quad mask 生成逻辑。
虽然它只是临时性 workaround，但它确实改变了边界处合法采样点是否会被错误丢弃。
disqualifiers: 该提交明确是临时 workaround，之后又被更精确的修复提交 c20232a97a3830ec8581ca65ee8cb346414bc69f 所取代。
evidence: 提交把包围 mask 和 barycentric 写入的 in-bounds 条件直接注释掉了，而不是改动周边流控。
在关闭检查后，dst_width、dst_height、x_loc_r 和 y_loc_r 立即被标记为 UNUSED。
后续修复把检查恢复为 ((x_loc_r >> 1) + i) 和 ((y_loc_r >> 1) + j)，这说明原始谓词使用了错误的坐标域。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: raster 或 tile evaluator 往往用更粗粒度或经过缩放的坐标来跟踪 quad 位置，而渲染目标宽高则处于像素坐标域。如果边界裁剪逻辑直接拿这些经过缩放的 quad 坐标去和像素空间尺寸比较，就会把本应保留的边缘采样点错误丢弃。这个源提交是通过直接关闭该错误检查来临时绕过问题。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 使用不匹配坐标域的 quad 边界裁剪
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: quad 靠近右边界或下边界，且 evaluator 内部保存的是缩放后或 tile 级别坐标，却直接与像素尺寸比较时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 重新启用原始的 in-bounds 条件，让其直接用未转换的 quad 坐标去和像素宽高比较。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 比较了错误的坐标表示
portability_notes: 可映射到任何需要在 quad/tile 坐标与像素坐标之间转换的 raster、tile 或 block evaluator。
其典型表现是边界处的合法采样被误判为越界，而不是图元内部的过度绘制。
该源提交本身是 workaround，但对故障注入很有用，因为它明确给出了应恢复的修复前谓词。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位在渲染目标边缘门控输出 mask 的每采样或每 quad 边界谓词。
比较时直接使用保存的 quad/tile 坐标，而不是先换算回像素坐标。
保持三角形内部测试不变，使回归只出现在边界裁剪行为上。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 围绕 mask 与 barycentric 写入的 quad evaluator 边界谓词
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 这个 workaround 直接注释掉了 `(x_loc_r + i) < dst_width && (y_loc_r + j) < dst_height` 这一检查，因为它会错误丢弃合法采样点。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复被注释掉的 `if ((x_loc_r + i) < dst_width && (y_loc_r + j) < dst_height)` 守卫，使 mask 与 barycentric 赋值再次受它约束。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 渲染窗口边缘的合法像素会因边界检查使用了错误坐标尺度而被错误清零。
evidence_for_injection: 该提交只改动了边界谓词，并未改变 edge-function 计算本身。
紧随其后的提交用右移版本替换了被移除的检查，从而解释了原始 bug 的根因。
提交标题明确把问题和 window-size 处理联系起来。
notes: 由于这是临时 workaround，分析根因时应结合后续正式修复一起看。
为了提高数据集可移植性，上面的说明描述了底层坐标域错误，而不是仅仅说“把检查注释掉”。
